senses.gloss: f. (v. לֶחִי, לִחְיָא), ל׳ דכרעא the splint-bone, the outer, smaller bone of the leg, fibula.
units: <cite ref="Yevamot 103a:9">Yeb. 103ᵃ</cite> <he>האי מאן דסגי על ל׳ דכרעיה</he> Ar. ed. Koh. (Var. <he>לו׳</he>; ed. <cite ref="L00031"><he>לִי׳</he></cite>) he who walks on his splint-bone (his feet being turned outward so as to form an obtuse angle).
